title: San Juan Excursions Whale & Wildlife Tours
specs: Frequent sightings of Bigg's Killer Whales nearly every day during season
Other wildlife includes gray whales, minke whales, harbor seals, bald eagles, Dall's porpoise, sea lions, and sea birds
Calm waters ideal for boating and wildlife viewing in the San Juan Islands
No stated weight or health restrictions
Private charters available for groups up to 80 guests
Discounts for groups of 10 or more on sea kayaking tours
includes: Complimentary transportation from ferry terminal for sea kayaking tours
Use of Odyssey vessel with padded seating, heated salons, restrooms, snack bar, and hydrophone for whale vocalizations
gap: Age minimum for sea kayaking tours not stated
blurb: Guests take guided whale watching and wildlife cruises aboard the Odyssey, a 65' U.S. Coast Guard certified vessel with indoor and outdoor viewing areas. Sea kayaking tours depart daily from Snug Harbor with complimentary transportation from the Friday Harbor ferry terminal. Private charters are available for special occasions and can depart from multiple locations in the Puget Sound area.
extraNote: Cancellations for less than 15 people must be made at least 48 hours prior for full refund · Cancellations for 15 or more people must be made at least 1 week prior for full refund · Prices do not include 8.3% Washington state sales tax or gratuity · No guarantee of whale sightings; free re-trip if no whales seen · Snug Harbor for sea kayaking tours; Friday Harbor for whale watching and private charters · April through early October
